name: Altwirt
beschreibung: The **Gasthof Altwirt** is located in the town center of **Kematen in Tirol**, about ten kilometers west of **Innsbruck**. The establishment operates as a **guesthouse with rooms**, embodying the traditional style of a Tyrolean country inn. The guest areas include a cozy dining room and a garden, both welcoming to hotel guests and passersby alike. The **kitchen** specializes in classic Tyrolean dishes, primarily using local ingredients. The rooms are practically furnished, offering the standard amenities typical for inns of this category. The location in **Kematen** makes it an ideal starting point for **activities in the Inntal region**, such as hiking or cycling. Guests can expect a relaxed atmosphere and warm, uncomplicated hospitality.
